verdict.rationale: Insomnia supports team collaboration via 'organizations' that let users share collections and environments securely with colleagues, RBAC for controlling access to shared resources, Cloud Sync, and Git Sync for team-based workflows with merge conflict resolution. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the shared-workspace sync experience in practice (community evidence is old and unrelated to sync features), and no detail on real-time collaborative editing.
